task.title: Support task ID slugs
task.description: Add slug-based task IDs (e.g., 021-support-task-id-slugs) instead of plain numeric IDs (021). Slugs auto-generate from task title using the slugify library, with a 50-character max length.
task.problem: Numeric task IDs (001, 002, etc.) are not memorable. Users cannot tell what a task is about without opening the task file. Directory listings show opaque folder names like 001/, 002/ which don't convey any meaning about the task content.
task.value: - Better recall: 021-slug-ids is easier to remember than just 021 - Self-documenting: Task purpose is visible in file listings and references - Faster navigation: Users can type partial slugs to find tasks quickly
task.acceptance-criteria:
Given a user is creating a new task And they have provided a task title When the task is created Then the task ID should be in format {number}-{slug} And the slug should be auto-generated from the title using slugify library And the slug should be truncated to 50 characters maximum And the task folder should use the full slug-based ID
Given an existing task with numeric ID When the system references that task Then the old numeric format should still be recognized for backwards compatibility
Given a user searches for a task When they type a partial slug Then the search should match against the slug portion of the ID
